title: MSF International Managing Director
description: Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years) Starting date: 01st of March 2027 Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified. Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement. Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement. The role ensures that MSF International: Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities. Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee); Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care; Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems; Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization; Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management; Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland. The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International. III. ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments. Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners. a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services. b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments. c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services. d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope. e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates. f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests. 2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making. Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated. a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance. b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International. c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations. d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International. e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use. f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law. g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans. 3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery. Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations. a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded. b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy. c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency. d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues. 4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements. Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives. a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International. b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation. c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements. d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel. e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International. f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International 5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce. Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture. a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning. b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. c. raw.description:
Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva

Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years)

Starting date: 01st of March 2027

Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified.

Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract

*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International:

  • Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

  • Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

  • Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

  • Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

  • Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

  • Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

  • Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

  • Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

  • Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

  • Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

  • Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.


Education

  • Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience

Experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations

  • MSF experience is a major asset

  • Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level

  • Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership

  • Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems

  • Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies

Knowledge

  • Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values.

  • High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters.

  • Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset.

  • Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change.

  • Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally.

  • High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation.

  • Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate.

  • Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience.

Languages

  • Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential.

  • French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Finance (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für den Finanzbereich an den beiden Standorten Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit dem lokalen Management zusammen und sorgen für Transparenz, einheitliche Finanzprozesse sowie eine verlässliche Berichterstattung.

Sie führen die Bereiche Accounting und Controlling und stehen im regelmässigen Austausch mit den lokalen Führungsteams sowie dem Coesia Headquarter. Darüber hinaus gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung der Finanzorganisation an beiden Standorten aktiv mit.

Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt in Kaiseraugst (ca. 80 %), mit regelmässiger Präsenz in Altendorf (ca. 20 %). Die Reisetätigkeit zwischen den beiden Standorten ist ein fester Bestandteil der Rolle.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortungen

  • Verantwortung für das gesamte Finanzreporting inklusive Ist-Zahlen, Forecasts und Budgetplanung

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Bereiche Accounting und Controlling

  • Harmonisierung der beiden unterschiedlichen ERP-Systemlandschaften an den Standorten

  • Gestaltung, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Finanzprozessen und internen Kontrollen

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung transparenter Reporting-Strukturen sowie relevanter KPIs

  • Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse

  • Verantwortung für Cashflow-Reporting, Liquiditätsüberwachung und Finanzplanung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Management sowie dem Coesia Headquarter in finanziellen und strategischen Fragestellungen

  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien, finanzieller Standards und Reporting-Anforderungen


Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Finance Manager, Head of Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsfunktion im Finanzbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Accounting und Controlling

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finanzreporting, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Cashflow-Management

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams im Bereich Finanzen, Accounting oder Controlling

  • Berufserfahrung in der Schweiz sowie gute Kenntnisse der Schweizer Rechnungslegungsstandards

  • Erfahrung in einem produzierenden oder industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise im Maschinenbau, in der Automatisierungstechnik oder im projektorientierten Geschäft

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, Strukturen und Prozesse aufzubauen, zu standardisieren und kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Erfahrung in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld und in der Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Konzernfunktionen

  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld mit einem hohen Mass an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Was wir bieten

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Attraktive Sozialleistungen und ein modernes Altersvorsorgemodell

  • Vergünstigungen beim Fahrzeugkauf

  • Dienstjubiläums- und Treueprämien

  • Unterstützung bei Aus- und Weiterbildungen

  • 25 Ferientage bis zum Alter von 49 Jahren, 28 Tage ab 50 Jahren und 30 Tage ab 60 Jahren

  • Kostenlose Parkplätze

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Verkehr

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg (Profit Sharing)

title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein
description: Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein About Keyrock Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility. raw.description:
Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

 

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Do you want to contribute to Western resilience? Do you want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving lives? Do you want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join us at CDDS to bring high-speed kinetic interceptor drones into the hands of armed forces, law enforcement agencies, and critical infrastructure operators. CDDS specialises in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralise malicious drones (Mavic drones, FPV racing drones, and fast fixed-wing drones). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimising risk to the surrounding area while effectively countering unauthorised or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Your Mission We are looking for a Business Development Manager to help grow CDDS's business from Switzerland across selected European and global markets. Your main focus will be identifying prospective customers and partners, opening new conversations, qualifying leads, and turning early interest into well-defined opportunities. Working closely with our engineering, product, operations, and leadership teams, you will connect customer needs with CDDS's capabilities and help build a strong, sustainable commercial pipeline. What You'll Do Help grow CDDS's business in selected European and global markets by building a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and partners. Research and identify relevant organisations, programmes, decision-makers, and potential partners across defence, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and the wider security ecosystem. Generate and qualify leads through targeted outreach, procurement monitoring, referrals, industry networks, events, and inbound enquiries. Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand customer needs, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and next steps, and document clear qualification criteria. Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and partners, maintain regular follow-up, and create momentum from first contact to active opportunity. Keep CRM records, lead statuses, contact information, and follow-up actions accurate and current, providing clear visibility of the developing pipeline. Coordinate customer meetings, demonstrations, and events with engineering, product, and operations teams, prepare relevant commercial materials, and manage follow-up actions. Support responses to requests for information, proposals, and public tenders by coordinating inputs and ensuring opportunities continue to progress. Work with leadership to prioritise qualified opportunities and support them through trials, proposals, contract discussions, and handover to delivery teams. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, market development, or a related customer-facing role, ideally in defence, security, public-sector technology, or another technical B2B environment. Demonstrated ability to identify prospects, conduct outreach, build relationships, and convert early conversations into qualified opportunities. Strong research and commercial curiosity, with the ability to understand an organisation, identify relevant stakeholders, and recognise where CDDS can create value. Confident communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical capabilities in clear customer and operational terms. Professional proficiency in English. Sie arbeiten in einem eingespielten Infrastrukturteam und bringen Ihre Erfahrung in Virtualisierung, Serverbetrieb und Automatisierung ein.

  • Sicherstellung des stabilen, sicheren und performanten Betriebs der On-Premises-Infrastruktur inklusive Monitoring und 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support
  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Virtualisierungsumgebungen mit VMware und Proxmox VE
  • Mitarbeit beim Aufbau und Ausbau der Container-Plattform mit Red Hat OpenShift und Docker
  • Administration, Wartung und Optimierung von Windows- und Linux-Servern
  • Automatisierung und Standardisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mittels PowerShell, Ansible/AWX und CI/CD-Pipelines
  • Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Alarmierung und Dashboards für einen proaktiven Plattformbetrieb
  • Mitarbeit bei Migrationen, Lifecycle-Management und Infrastrukturprojekten
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen sowie Wissenstransfer an das interne Team

Muss-Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung (EFZ mit Weiterbildung, HF, FH oder vergleichbare Qualifikation)
  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung als System Engineer oder Plattform Engineer im Betrieb komplexer On-Premises-Infrastrukturen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Virtualisierungstechnologien, insbesondere VMware oder vergleichbaren Lösungen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Windows Server und Linux
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Automatisierung mit PowerShell, Ansible oder CI/CD
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Verständnis von Schweizerdeutsch
  • Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit klarer Kommunikation und Freude am Wissenstransfer

Von Vorteil sind:

  • Erfahrung mit Container-Technologien wie Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes oder Docker
  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Ansible/AWX und Monitoring-Lösungen
  • Kenntnisse in Storage-, SAN- und Backup-Umgebungen, beispielsweise Huawei Storage, Cisco SAN, Veeam oder NetVault
  • Erfahrung mit Patch Management (WSUS, Azure Update Manager)
  • Erfahrung in öffentlichen Verwaltungen oder grösseren IT-Betriebsorganisationen

title: Projectmanager Datacenters
description: Krijg jij energie van het leiden van grote en complexe projecten waarin techniek, samenwerking en commercie samenkomen? Weet jij multidisciplinaire teams mee te nemen en houd je tegelijkertijd grip op kwaliteit, planning, budget en klantbelang? Als Projectmanager Datacenters bij Deerns neem jij de regie over uitdagende advies- en ontwerpprojecten binnen een sector die continu in ontwikkeling is.   De uitdaging   Als Projectmanager Datacenters ben je verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grote en complexe projecten binnen de datacentersector. Je stuurt multidisciplinaire projectteams aan en zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen de afgesproken kwaliteit, planning en financiële kaders worden gerealiseerd. Daarbij combineer je projectmanagement met technische inhoud. Je begrijpt wat er binnen de verschillende technische disciplines speelt en weet de juiste specialisten met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder technisch detail uit te werken, maar bent inhoudelijk sterk genoeg om keuzes te beoordelen, risico's te herkennen en richting te geven aan het project. De datacenterwereld stelt hoge eisen aan onder andere betrouwbaarheid, energie-efficiëntie en veiligheid. Binnen Deerns werken we aan uiteenlopende projecten, van de ontwikkeling van nieuwe datacenters tot uitbreiding, verduurzaming en renovatie van bestaande locaties. Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het project zelf. Ook de samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, het financiële resultaat en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen behoren tot jouw rol.   Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:  Het leiden en aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams; Het bewaken van kwaliteit, planning, budget, scope en projectresultaat; Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, planningen, begrotingen en voorstellen; Het organiseren en leiden van kick-offs, project- en coördinatieoverleggen; Het tijdig signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en hierop gericht bijsturen; Het afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, architecten, aannemers, installateurs en andere projectpartners; Het onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en het bespreken van meerwerk en aanvullende opdrachten; Het bewaken van de financiële voortgang en bijdragen aan een gezonde projectmarge; Het bijdragen aan het verbeteren van projectprocessen en onze manier van samenwerken.   Het team en de projecten Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en multidisciplinair team met een gedeelde passie voor datacentertechnologie en duurzame techniek. Binnen het team komen verschillende expertises samen, waaronder werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, brandveiligheid en duurzaamheid. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier staan centraal. Je werkt aan nationale en internationale projecten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers binnen de datacenterbranche. Daarbij krijg je te maken met complexe technische vraagstukken en verschillende stakeholders. Geen project is hetzelfde en juist die combinatie van techniek, organisatie en samenwerking maakt deze functie uitdagend. Door jouw ervaring speel je daarnaast een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en helpt ons om onze projecten steeds slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.   Dit ben jij   Je bent een ervaren projectmanager die techniek, mensen en commercie met elkaar weet te verbinden. Ook wanneer projecten complex worden, behoud je het overzicht en weet je de juiste prioriteiten te stellen. Je durft beslissingen te nemen, communiceert gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus en creëert duidelijkheid voor zowel de opdrachtgever als jouw projectteam. Je geeft mensen de ruimte om vanuit hun eigen expertise bij te dragen, maar bent duidelijk wanneer richting of besluitvorming nodig is. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het project van vandaag: je begrijpt het belang van duurzame klantrelaties en herkent kansen om onze samenwerking met opdrachtgevers verder uit te bouwen. Verder beschik je over: Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een technische achtergrond; Ruime ervaring binnen complexe technische ontwerp- en/of adviesprojecten; Bij voorkeur circa 15 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan een belangrijk deel in projectleiding of projectmanagement; Brede multidisciplinaire technische kennis; Ervaring met het aansturen, motiveren en coachen van projectteams; Kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, planning en financiële projectbeheersing; Kennis van relevante contractuele en bouwrechtelijke aspecten; Commercieel inzicht en ervaring met klant- en stakeholdermanagement; Een resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte manier van werken.   Dit bieden wij   Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.623 en € 8.033 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise. Een functie van 32-40 uur per week. Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal.  Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht.  Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen.  Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken.  Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan.  Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV.    Over Deerns   Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters.    Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!   Kennis maken?   Wil je meer weten over werken bij Deerns? Neem dan contact op met Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) via +31 6 11 66 75 44. Wil je meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Neem dan contact op met Ester Vlielander (Unit Director Data Center en Life Sciences) via +31 6 50 73 68 41 Ben je enthousiast geworden? Reageer met jouw cv via de sollicitatie button. title: Senior G&E Executive
description: SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE Is organizing truly your passion, and do you know how to turn a client request into a successful and memorable event? We are looking for a Senior G&E Executive to strengthen our team at the Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon ! WHAT DOES YOUR DAY AS A SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE LOOK LIKE? As a Senior G&E Executive, you are responsible for the organization and coordination of groups and events for Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon. From the first inquiry until the final evaluation, you make sure every detail is taken care of. You manage a broad range of meetings, conferences, dinners, group bookings, and special events. With your experience and commercial mindset, you know how to translate clients' wishes into successful events while identifying opportunities to maximize revenue. You work closely with operational departments and are a trusted point of contact for both clients and colleagues. As a senior member of the team, you take ownership of more complex requests and events, support your colleagues when needed, and contribute to continuously improving our commercial approach and way of working. A FEW RESPONSIBILITIES: Managing groups, meetings, and events from the initial inquiry through to execution and follow-up. Maximizing revenue and guest satisfaction by responding quickly to requests, converting inquiries into confirmed business, and identifying upselling opportunities. Using your commercial insight to strategically manage pricing, availability, and event planning in line with the hotels' revenue objectives. Taking ownership of larger and more complex groups and events and ensuring all agreements and details are communicated accurately. Building and maintaining strong relationships with corporate clients, agencies, event planners, and other business partners. Ensuring contracts, deposits, cancellations, and invoicing are handled accurately and according to agreed procedures. Coordinating menus, packages, room requirements, and additional services while balancing the client's wishes with the commercial opportunities for the hotels. Working closely with operational departments to ensure a smooth handover and successful execution of each event. Supporting and sharing knowledge with colleagues within the G&E team and contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and commercial performance. Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade is located in the heart of international The Hague, right next to the green Van Stolkpark. The hotel lies between The Hague city center and Scheveningen beach. Guests can relax in our Promenade Healthclub & Spa or enjoy delicious international dishes at LEO’S International Flavors. Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade has 178 rooms and features a classic yet modern design, reflected throughout the hotel’s atmosphere. The hotel also offers 10 meeting rooms, making it the perfect choice for both business and leisure guests. Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon has been an icon at The Hague Central Station since 1978 and is part of Leonardo Hotels. Centrally located, with a fantastic view and all the famous attractions within easy reach, the hotel has 143 rooms and several special meeting rooms. On the first floor of the hotel you will find our bar and restaurant "The Livingroom", where we create a real feeling of home for our guests. As Leonardo Hotels Benelux, we are part of the larger Leonardo Hotels Group and responsible for all activities for our 28 hotels in the Netherlands and Belgium. At Leonardo Hotels, we care deeply about personal growth, connection, and making an impact together. On average, our colleagues work with us for four years because we always look for good internal career opportunities, and we are quite proud of that! WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT ADDITION TO OUR TEAM At least 2 to 3 years of relevant experience within Groups & Events, Meeting & Events, or a similar hospitality environment. Bachelor-level working and thinking capability (HBO), preferably combined with a hospitality-related education such as Hotel Management or Facility Management. Experience with both corporate and social events and confidence in managing larger or more complex bookings. Experience with Opera Sales & Catering is strongly preferred. Strong command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written. A strong commercial mindset and the ability to recognize opportunities to increase conversion and revenue. You are organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and making decisions. Professional, service-oriented, and a true team player who enjoys sharing knowledge with colleagues. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling you to connect easily with clients and internal stakeholders. Strong numerical insight and the ability to think strategically while keeping an eye on the details. You remain calm and solution-oriented when plans change, because in events, they sometimes do! To be considered for this role, applicants must be an EU citizen or hold a valid work permit for the Netherlands. WHAT YOU RECEIVE FROM US • Travel allowance from 10 kilometers. • Overtime can be paid out or saved as extra time off. • Training and development opportunities. • Clear internal growth opportunities. • Access to a mental well-being support platform. • Tax-friendly purchase options through a benefit program. • Worldwide employee discount programs. • An introduction experience including an overnight stay, dinner and breakfast. • The mentioned salary is gross per month and applies to candidates aged 20 and above. COME SOON TO DRINK COFFEE WITH US! Do you see yourself taking the lead in creating successful groups and events for two unique hotels in The Hague? Then we would love to meet you! Send us your resume and motivation and let us know why you would be a great addition to our G&E team. Questions? title: Architecture Internship Dutch | March 2027 (2)
description: Geef je carrière een vliegende start MVRDV is een wereldwijd gerenommeerd architectuur- en stedenbouwkundig bureau met het hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en kantoren in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. MVRDV werd in 1993 opgericht door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries en zet zich in voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve, maatschappelijk verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als stagiair bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 200 professionals uit ruim 40 verschillende landen. Je doet praktijkervaring op in baanbrekende projecten, werkt samen met toonaangevende architecten en verlegt de grenzen van ontwerp en innovatie. Ben jij gepassioneerd over architectuur en wil je leren in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je. Let op: We verzoeken recruitmentbureaus vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde kandidaten of profielen voor deze vacature aan te leveren. Wij verzorgen het wervingsproces intern en accepteren geen voorwaarden of vergoedingen met betrekking tot ongevraagde doorverwijzingen. Sollicitatieprocedure Je kunt je sollicitatie indienen vanaf nu tot en met 16 november 2026 . De gesprekken vinden plaats tussen 23 november en 11 december 2026 . Succesvolle kandidaten starten op 1 maart 2027 . Belangrijk: Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze stage moet je gedurende de volledige stageperiode, van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027 , ingeschreven blijven staan aan een daarvoor in aanmerking komende opleiding aan een universiteit of hogeschool. Over het Design Collective Het Design Collective van MVRDV is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve en duurzame gebouwen en constructies. We werken aan een breed scala aan projecten, van kleinschalige woningbouw tot grootschalige commerciële en culturele complexen. Bekijk enkele voorbeelden van onze projecten op: https://www.mvrdv.com/projects. Het Design Collective richt zich op projecten in de volgende regio’s: Nederland Azië DACH-regio Franstalige landen Noord-Amerika Centraal- en Oost-Europa Taiwan Midden-Oosten Over de functie Als Architectuurstagiair bij MVRDV kom je terecht in een dynamische omgeving waar gedurfde ideeën en snel schakelen dagelijks centraal staan. Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

raw.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? Do you love diving into data, spotting opportunities, and turning ideas into measurable growth? Are you excited by opening new acquisition channels and finding smarter ways to grow in an AI-driven world?

AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue.

You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale.

A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue.

You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape.

Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results.

It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance.

After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch.

On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch.

Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps.

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features

title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
description: wo- afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten? Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. Je gaat onder andere: bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS. We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn: Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding. Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie. Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten. Je kunt goed programmeren in R. Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen; jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse; jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt; ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Data & Intelligence
raw.description:
GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. For over 15 years, real estate and infrastructure managers have reported to us, building a dataset of 150,000+ assets across more than 2,000 portfolios. Together with Asset Impact, which tracks emissions for over 300,000 physical assets and 77,000 companies, we’re turning that data into decision-grade intelligence for investors, lenders, index providers and regulators.

We’re building a new Client & Data Intelligence organization to showcase the value of the data to investors and develop new use cases within the ecosystem. It brings sales, product and data teams together under one leader, the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer. This role is the person who makes that organization run. The role is based out of Amsterdam.

The Role

You’ll work directly with the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer as the strategist and operator at the center of a newly formed team. Your job is to keep decisions moving, teams connected and priority work getting finished, so the leadership team can focus on clients and growth.

It’s a role for someone who can shape a problem and then see it through. One week you might be building the business case for a new data product; the next you’re tightening the sales pipeline, preparing a board update and unblocking a delivery issue between product and engineering. You’ll move between sales enablement, product and data operations, and you’ll be trusted to run several projects at once without dropping any of them.

You’ll see the whole business, from client conversations to product decisions to the CEO’s agenda, and you’ll have influence over how a new organization works.

What you will do

Strategy and priority projects

  • Lead the organization’s highest-priority initiatives end to end, for example pricing, our investor program, entry into new markets and maturing the data strategy
  • Frame the problem, build the analysis, align stakeholders and drive the work through to a decision and implementation
  • Bring a recommendation, not just options

Operating rhythm and decision-making

  • Run the team’s operating cadence: weekly deal desk, fortnightly product council and monthly business review
  • Own the decision log, so it’s always clear what was decided, by whom and what happens next
  • Spot blockers between sales, product and data teams early and clear them

Commercial operations and sales enablement

  • Own pricing and support deal structuring with the sales team
  • Keep pipeline and ARR reporting accurate and trusted, with one view across GRESB
  • Work with sales and product to make sure the team has what it needs to showcase the value of the data products

Reporting and communication

  • Build and run the monthly CEO dashboard and KPI reporting
  • Prepare senior leadership, board and client materials that are clear, concise and decision-ready
  • Act as the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer’s point of contact when they’re away

What success looks like

In your first six months

  • The operating rhythm is running and people rely on it
  • The decision log is live and used
  • There’s one trusted ARR view across GRESB data products

By the end of your first year

  • At least two priority projects have been taken from problem to implemented decision
  • Leadership and board reporting runs on a predictable monthly cycle with little rework
  • Sales, product and data teams describe fewer handoff issues, and escalations get resolved faster

Requirements

  • Around 6–10 years of experience
  • A grounding in top-tier management consulting or Big Four advisory, in strategy, sustainability, data or technology
  • Ideally, spent time at a sustainability data, ESG ratings, real asset or financial data business
  • Strong business acumen and ability to work well in a cross-functional, global environment.
  • Experience implementing AI or advanced analytics solutions within a commercial or sales environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM, data analytics, and visualization tools.
  • A working understanding of how data products are packaged, priced and sold

How you work

  • You think in structure: you can break down an ambiguous problem, find what matters and build a clear path forward
  • You finish things. You run several projects at once and see each one through to the end
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented and work well in systems
  • You write and present clearly, whether it’s a one-page update or a board deck
  • You get things done without formal authority, by earning trust across sales, product and engineering
  • You’re comfortable moving between the big picture and the detail in the same day

Benefits

  • Involvement in a fast growing international data-driven company
  • Opportunity to work with a highly talented and committed team in a supportive environment with strong camaraderie
  • Annual leave of 25 days per calendar year
